data.name: Dungeon Monster Master
data.detailed_description:
- Dungeon Monster Master

An ultimate action RPG set in an infinite open-world where you collect monsters, farm, and build your own world!

Become the protagonist of a mysterious world, tame and grow over 200 cute monsters, and build your own home.

Craft your own tools and face powerful boss monsters waiting for you.

Your grown monsters will protect you.

Enjoy thrilling boss battles in boss rush mode.

Explore a randomly changing, procedurally generated open world.

- Boss Dungeon with Powerful Bosses Waiting

You become the protagonist of a mysterious monster world and must find dungeons containing boss monsters to challenge them and save the world.

Collect and train monsters to fight boss monsters, defeat them, and obtain dungeon badges.

Collect all badges to challenge the final boss.

Combo attacks, dodging, and thrilling boss battles await you.

- Monster Collection and Training

Over 200 different monsters inhabit this mysterious world.

You can collect and tame these monsters.

Each monster has different abilities and growth rates.

Build your ultimate monster party of companions.

Well-trained monsters evolve into even stronger forms through evolution.

Collect special eggs found throughout the world and raise the monsters that hatch from them.

Build monster farms and raise them there.

Collect all monsters in the world and complete your monster encyclopedia collection.

- Various Attributes and Skills

There are many different attributes in this mysterious monster world:

Pickaxe, sword, fire, water, grass, electricity, angel, demon, darkness, light...

Various skills and magic also contain different attributes.

Understand and utilize attribute interactions to defeat your enemies.

In boss rush battles, your understanding of skills and magic will truly shine.

- Master All Crafting Techniques of the World

In this mysterious world, you can learn how to build houses.

The world endlessly generates various houses across randomly generated terrain.

By breaking houses, you learn how to craft them.

By breaking blocks, you learn how to craft blocks.

Discover and break anything in the world: weapons, pickaxes, torches—everything.

You will eventually be able to craft everything.

- Build Your Own City

Using the crafting techniques you learn, you can build and manage your own city.

First, clear the surrounding area to establish your city.

Then build the city you envision.

If you want to improve the environment, construct air purification buildings.

If you want to strengthen monster training, build monster farms.

To secure resources, build factories to increase city money.

- Tower Defense

Using crafting techniques discovered in the world, you can build towers that protect you and your allies.

Create various traps to gain an advantage in battle.

Your unique tower creations become the key to protecting everyone.

- Infinite Random Open World

Enjoy exploration in an endlessly expanding, randomly generated world.

Experience changing terrain, monsters, and events every time you play.

Your experience will sometimes help you, and other times surprise you with completely new situations.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required
